This item, kept at the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing (CPN), is discussed in [Q8FCH7LF]: 294-295.
In view of the signature, it was part of the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang collection. [8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi zha 17."
